categories.main_business_segments: Chengdu Zhimingda Electronics Co., Ltd primarily operates in the design, development, and sales of customized embedded computer modules and solutions. Its products serve key national sectors including airborne, missile-borne, naval, vehicle-mounted, satellite, unmanned equipment, and soldier equipment embedded systems. The company focuses on embedded computing hardware and software integration for defense and aerospace applications.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages proprietary embedded real-time operating systems, FPGA-based hardware customization, multi-core parallel processing, high-reliability thermal design, high-speed data bus technologies, AI-based image perception and processing, and high-reliability power supply modules. Production is customized and made-to-order, combining in-house manufacturing with outsourced processing, emphasizing low-cost design, high reliability, and compliance with stringent defense standards.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are major Chinese national defense groups and their affiliated research institutes, including China Electronics Technology Group, China Aerospace Science and Technology Corporation, China Aviation Industry Corporation, and others. The end markets are national defense and aerospace sectors, focusing on embedded computing for aircraft, missiles, naval vessels, satellites, unmanned systems, and soldier equipment.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily within China, with headquarters and manufacturing facilities located in Chengdu, Sichuan Province. Its customer base and projects are concentrated in domestic national defense and aerospace sectors.
categories.supply_chain_position: Zhimingda operates mainly in the midstream segment of the supply chain, focusing on the design, development, and manufacturing of embedded computer modules that are integrated into larger defense and aerospace systems. It procures electronic components and integrated circuits upstream and supplies customized modules downstream to system integrators and final equipment manufacturers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes continuous R&D investment in next-generation avionics buses, ultra-high-speed inter-board communication, AI-driven image perception and intelligent processing, inertial navigation signal acquisition, and high-capacity storage. It emphasizes domestic core chip and real-time OS development, multi-core and multi-processor systems, and low-power, high-reliability embedded solutions. The R&D strategy includes expanding product lines, enhancing customization, and integrating software and hardware for comprehensive embedded solutions.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of customized embedded computer modules and solutions to national defense customers. The company follows a make-to-order production model, with revenue recognized upon delivery and acceptance of products. It also benefits from government subsidies and investment income related to its strategic projects.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with large state-owned enterprises and affiliated research institutes in the Chinese national defense embedded computing market. While these state-owned entities have historical advantages and larger scale, Zhimingda leverages its technological innovation, cost-effectiveness, and flexibility as a leading private enterprise in this specialized sector. It holds a recognized position as a national-level specialized and innovative 'little giant' enterprise.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, Zhimingda reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 663 million, a 22.58% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 96.3 million, up 27.73%. The company has shown steady growth with increasing R&D investment (about 18.59% of revenue) and expanding order backlog, despite some fluctuations in order volume. Total assets stood at approximately RMB 1.53 billion with net assets of RMB 1.09 billion, reflecting a solid financial scale and growth trajectory.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Zhimingda emphasizes its comprehensive embedded computing technology platform combining hardware and software customization tailored to stringent national defense requirements. Its products feature high reliability, environmental adaptability, electromagnetic compatibility, and long lifecycle support. The company differentiates itself through advanced proprietary technologies in multi-core processing, AI-based image perception, high-speed data exchange, and low-cost, high-performance embedded solutions, enabling it to meet complex and evolving defense system demands.
